paragraphs: A professional, interactive web application for analyzing historical weather data and forecasting future temperatures for Washington DC. Built with Streamlit and powered by the Open-Meteo API.
View Live Weather Chart - Interactive forecast updated daily via GitHub Actions

✅ Educational - Learn how ML approaches time series prediction ✅ Comparative Analysis - See how ML forecasts differ from physics-based models ✅ Pattern Recognition - ML excels at identifying historical patterns ✅ Production-Ready - Includes caching, error handling, and logging
features: Real-time Weather Data: Fetches live historical and forecast data from Open-Meteo API
Customizable Historical Period: Choose from 7, 14, 30, or 60 days of historical data
Confidence Intervals: Toggle 95% confidence intervals around forecasts (uncertainty increases with time)
Interactive Visualizations: Fully interactive Plotly charts with zoom, pan, hover tooltips, and range slider
Hover Details: Precise temperature readings on hover
